Ben / Sara — quick legal note and required evidence list from our side.

1) Role & Module: Confirming Redwood will be Processor. For the new SCCs set, our recommended tile is the Processor Module (the clause set tailored to controller -> processor). We only accept Controller-to-Controller election where Clearwell is retaining functional control over processing and requests a different commercial structure; that is not the default for our SaaS offering.

2) Evidence checklist (what we will attach to the executed DPA / SCCs package):
- SOC 2 Type II report (full report available under NDA; we typically provide a redacted PDF and a SOC letter).
- Latest penetration test executive summary (PDF).
- Current subprocessors register (CSV).
- Data flow diagram and list of categories of personal data processed (PDF).
- DPA with SCCs: we'll attach our standard DPA with the Processor Module; if Clearwell requires BAA/HIPAA-specific text we can provide a limited addendum but that needs C-level approval for broad policy reasons.

3) HIPAA note: because Clearwell is a healthcare provider processing clinical PHI, we will evaluate a BAA addendum. Laura explains: for most customers we include a targeted addendum that mirrors our DPA security controls and references the SCCs where appropriate. That addendum is not blanket — it must be scoped to the features where PHI is processed.

4) Delegated approval: Ben, your delegation checklist looks good. To be explicit about process: pre-authorized signoff for DPAs under $50k ARR or one-year term < 12 months is available to Sales + AM with a mandatory legal attach (SOC2 + subprocessors + DFD). Anything outside that must go through Legal Director approval (me).

Estimated timings after Clearwell confirms scope:
- SOC2 + subprocessors + DFD: 3 business days
- DPA with SCCs + DocuSign envelope prepared: 2 business days after that
- If BAA addendum required: allow additional 5 business days for legal review/exec signoff.

Sara — if you can confirm scope today, we'll draft the DPA and open DocuSign.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
